REPORT
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
File No. B. D. 9369
Date 2/11/39
Station.
Date October 26, 1939.

Subject F. E. WOETZEL, German.

Made by D. S. Fitts. Forwarded by 〔此处转录不清〕

In accordance with the instructions of the
Commissioner of Police, the German Consul-General, Mr.
E. FISCHER, was interviewed at 10 a.m. October 21,
1939 in respect of a claim laid by a German national.
Subsequent enquiries coupled with the
conversation that passed at the interview have revealed
the following :-
The German in question, Mr. K. E. WOETZEL,
residing at 429 Grosvenor Gardens, was recently
proposed by Dr. F. REISS for temporary membership in
the Husi Country Club, 580 Hungjao Road. Now this
Club, which is international in aspect, has suffered
considerably during the past two years since the
occupation by the Japanese of the Western area in
which the Club premises are situated and it was in
an effort to secure further support for the Club that
temporary members, not paying the subscription fee,
were permitted to join.
Two members of the General Committee, Mr.
R. A. KNEULYN, Netherlander and Mr. R. N. SWANN,
British, constituted the "approval" Committee, and
after due consideration, Mr. WOETZEL was approved by
the former as a temporary member.
A few days ago, another German member of
the Club named Reyfus (?) and his wife remarked to
the Chinese Resident Secretary that neither Mr.
WOETZEL nor Mrs. WOETZEL enjoyed spotless reputations

警署。
日期 1939年10月26日。

事由 F. E. WOETZEL，德国人。

制作人 D. S. Fitts。转发人 〔此处转录不清〕

遵照警务处处长的指示，于1939年10月21日上午10时会见了德国总领事 E. FISCHER 先生，就一名德国国民提出的申诉事宜进行商谈。随后的调查以及会谈中的对话揭示了以下情况：
涉事德国人 K. E. WOETZEL 先生，居住于格罗夫纳花园（Grosvenor Gardens）429号，近期由 F. REISS 博士提名为虹桥路580号沪西乡村俱乐部（Husi Country Club）的临时会员。该俱乐部具有国际性质，自日军占领俱乐部所在地所在的西区以来，在过去两年中遭受了相当大的损失，为了争取对俱乐部的进一步支持，允许不缴纳会费的临时会员加入。
总委员会的两名成员，荷兰人 R. A. KNEULYN 先生和英国人 R. N. SWANN 先生，组成了“审批”委员会，经适当审议后，WOETZEL 先生被前者批准为临时会员。
几天前，另一位名叫 Reyfus (?) 的德国俱乐部会员及其妻子向中方驻会秘书表示，WOETZEL 先生和 WOETZEL 夫人名声都不清白，

（左侧批注框内文字）：
警方
特别处副总监
助理处长
致德国总领事的信函，
指出在调查中
并未发现任何不利于
Woetzel 先生的记录，
他从事的是合法业务
以外的活动。

（底部印章）：
警务处处长办公室
上海公共租界工部局警务处

and were far from desirable people. Still later,
another member informed the Resident Secretary that
Mr. WOETZEL was under the suspicion of the local
American authorities as a narcotic dealer and that
Mrs. WOETZEL's arrest by the Municipal Police was
imminent, a warrant having been issued. The offence
was not specified.

As a result of these allegations, Mr.
WOETZEL was asked to resign, which he did.

This information has been secured from
sources closely connected with the Husi Club and
may be regarded as accurate.

There is no question of the Police having
reported him as being mixed up in drug-trafficking,
a fact which Mr. FISCHER readily admits.

Mr. WOETZEL, in his complaint to the German
authorities, stated he had nothing to hide, but felt
that perhaps the Police could ascertain whence these
rumours emanated. Indeed Mr. WOETZEL makes no
allegation that the Police reported him.

In view of these circumstances, therefore,
Mr. WOETZEL expressed a desire that the German
Consulate-General be officially acquainted with the
facts of the affair and with the object of proving
that he was a bona-fide and respectable German citizen,
requested that his antecedents be checked.

且绝非受人欢迎之人。更晚些时候，另一名会员告知驻会秘书，WOETZEL 先生被当地美国当局怀疑为毒品贩子，且工部局警务处即将逮捕 WOETZEL 夫人，因为已签发了逮捕令。具体罪名未予说明。

由于这些指控，WOETZEL 先生被要求辞职，他照办了。

此信息来自与沪西俱乐部关系密切的消息源，可视为准确。

警方绝无举报其卷入毒品交易之事，FISCHER 先生也 readily 承认这一事实。

WOETZEL 先生在向德国当局申诉时称，他没有什么可隐瞒的，但觉得或许警方可以查明这些谣言源自何处。事实上，WOETZEL 先生并未指控警方举报了他。

鉴于上述情况，WOETZEL 先生表示希望德国总领事馆正式知悉此事真相，并为了证明他是一名真诚且体面的德国公民，请求对其过往经历进行核查。

    Mr. WOEHL, after outlining these details,
then asked whether it would be possible for the Police
to communicate with him advising him whether anything
was known or not to Mr. WOEHL's detriment.

    Mr. WOEHL, whose wife is a rather highly-
strung and very ambitious Jewess, is not well received
in the German community and on the face of things it
would seem that he desires "official approval" from
the German authorities to re-establish his character.

    He has in the past, due to his Chinese trading
connections, been the subject of official investigation
by both the Special Branch and the Narcotic Section,
but in neither instance has anything come to light that
has proved detrimental to his character. The Narcotic
Section, at the time of the Brandstaetter Case, naturally
checked Brandstaetter's associates, but though Mr.
WOEHL's name was mentioned as such, nothing resulted
from the ensuing investigation.

    Mr. WOEHL by profession is a chemist and is
at present very well off financially. The possibility
of his having business enemies cannot be excluded, but
the impression is gained from enquiries made that
although he has been barred from the Kusi Club, he is
utilizing this point as an excuse to curry favour in
the eyes of the local German community and thus establish
himself as a person of some importance.

                                D. S.
D. C. ( Special Branch ).

    WOEHL 先生在概述这些细节后，询问警方是否有可能与他联系，告知是否掌握任何对 WOEHL 先生不利的信息。

    WOEHL 先生的妻子是一位相当神经质且野心勃勃的犹太女性，他在德国社群中并不受欢迎，从表面情况来看，他似乎希望获得德国当局的“官方认可”以恢复其名誉。

    过去，由于其与中国贸易界的联系，他曾是特别处和禁毒科官方调查的对象，但在两次调查中均未发现任何损害其名誉的事实。禁毒科在 Brandstaetter 案件期间，自然对 Brandstaetter 的同伙进行了核查，虽然 WOEHL 先生的名字作为同伙之一被提及，但随后的调查并未产生任何结果。

    WOEHL 先生的职业是化学师，目前经济状况非常宽裕。不能排除他有商业敌人的可能性，但从调查中获得印象是，尽管他被拒于沪西俱乐部（Kusi Club）门外，他正利用这一点作为借口，以在当地德国社群眼中博取好感，从而确立自己作为某种重要人物的地位。

                                D. S.
特别处副总监。

October 27, 39.

German Consul General,
SHANGHAI.

Sir,

Mr. K. E. Woetzel.

I have the honour to inform you that there is
nothing disclosed by investigations of Police records
to indicate that Mr. K. E. Woetzel, is or has been, en-
gaged in other than legitimate business.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔此处转录不清〕. K. M. Bourne.

Commissioner of Police.

SCW/.

德国总领事，
上海。

K. E. Woetzel 先生。

谨此通知阁下，经调查警方档案，未发现任何迹象表明 K. E. Woetzel 先生现在或曾经从事合法业务以外的活动。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
